messages:
maya: Heads-up — prepping a cost-signal playbook for Acero, Helix and the new onboarding batch for the QBR next Wed. Main asks: verify token forecasts, set budget alerts, and coordinate enablement docs. Can people confirm owners?
sophia: I can own the playbook draft + run token forecasts for Acero/Helix. ETA EOD Mon. I need historical monthly avg + peak day. Do we have saved queries I should use?
ev an: I will share the billing query — use this in BigQuery to get tokens by month: ```SELECT customer, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ts) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ts) AS month, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM billing.tokens WHERE customer IN ('acero','helix') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY year, month;``` multiply tokens by `cost_per_token` to get spend. For Helix assume 1.15 M/M growth baseline unless Sophia wants a different projection.
devon: For the onboarding batch (5 customers) most heavy calls use embeddings + chat. If we enable prefix/KV caching and longer-lived KV we should see ~15–25% token reduction depending on prompt type. I can run a quick sim.
maya: Sophia — please run forecasts with and without caching enabled. Also set budget alerts: production budgets at 80% and 95%. Who can create alerts in the Console for hosted customers vs dedicated?
owen: I can create alerts for Dedicated accounts. For hosted customers I don't have direct access to their Console billing — paging @billing-bot to create hosted alerts where possible.
billing-bot: Request acknowledged. Creating hosted budget alert for Acero: $6000 monthly with 80% and 95% thresholds. Notifications -> #billing-alerts and evan@redwood.com.
sophia: Quick question — what is Acero's current commit level for Dedicated? I thought they were at ~40% of suggested commit. Need that to compute cost delta.
evan: Correct — Acero is under-committed (40%). Marking them as renewal-risk. Recommendation: show cost/unit improvement moving to reserved dedicated for the QBR. I'll draft the comparison table.
maya: Also we need a short enablement/demo for their infra team on batching + model selection tradeoffs. Devon — can you lead a 30–45m session and include a sample config and cost comparison?
devon: Yep. Available Tue or Thu next week. I'll prep a short demo repo + config snippets and live example showing `batch_size`, `max_tokens`, and `kv_cache_enabled`. Sample snippet I'll include: ```models:
  - name: gpt-optimized
    batch_size: 32
    kv_cache_enabled: true
    quantize: bf16``` Demo link I'll post: https://git.redwood.dev/onboarding/caching-snippets
maya: Action items recap: Sophia — forecast CSV + two scenarios (with/without caching) by EOD Mon; Owen — create hosted alerts for remaining hosted customers on Tue; Devon — prep and run demo (Tue/Thu); Evan — draft renewal note / cost-comparison to hand to AE. I'll consolidate into the QBR deck after Sophia posts. :thumbsup:
owen: noted.
sophia: I'll post the forecast thread with CSV and charts and include the BigQuery used + assumptions.
maya: Thanks all — let's sync if any blockers. We'll capture this in the QBR cost slide and in the renewal playbook.
